subtitles.text: *Mizoram*: 21,081 km² of hills between Bangladesh and Myanmar
The *Kaladan* corridor: Kolkata by sea to *Sittwe*, up the river to Paletwa, then by road into Mizoram
*13 September 2025*: the 51.38 km Bairabi-Sairang line brings rail to Aizawl
India-ASEAN trade: *$123 billion* a year. Mizoram sits on the shortest land path east
*Scenario.* A new *right-wing* government takes office with a Mizo-first programme
*Autobahn-style* public works: an expressway grid built by Mizo workers, starting in the north
By *2032* all 11 district headquarters and the border gates are linked: *641 km*
*50,000* new urban homes, owned by Mizo families who rent to visitors and workers
*Farm reform*: the last jhum plots move to terraces, orchards and agroforestry
*Mizo battalions*: thousands of young Mizos in uniform, guarding the border
A *solar belt*: 1,000 MW, a ninth of the state's 9.09 GW potential
*Compute hubs*: Mizo youth run AI servers and Bitcoin mining on solar power
Today three *Autonomous District Councils* govern the south: Lai, Mara and Chakma
The scenario merges them into *one administration* for the whole state
*2047.* On trend GSDP reaches Rs 2.4 lakh crore; at 12% a year, *Rs 4.1 lakh crore*
